loan-emi-calculator.title: Loan & EMI Calculator
loan-emi-calculator.description: Calculate monthly EMI, total interest and total repayment.
loan-emi-calculator.formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n − 1), where r is annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100 and n is the number of monthly instalments.
loan-emi-calculator.assumptions: Reducing-balance loan with equal monthly payments; zero-interest case is principal divided by months. Excludes lender fees, insurance and rate resets.

compound-interest-sip-calculator.title: Compound Interest & SIP Calculator
compound-interest-sip-calculator.description: Estimate compound growth and monthly SIP investment value.
compound-interest-sip-calculator.formula: Future value = initial investment × (1+r)^n + Σ monthly contribution × (1+r)^(n−i), where r = annual rate ÷ 1200 and n = years × 12.
compound-interest-sip-calculator.assumptions: Assumes a constant monthly rate derived from the annual rate and end-of-month contributions; returns are illustrative, not guaranteed.

discount-percentage-calculator.title: Discount & Percentage Calculator
discount-percentage-calculator.description: Calculate discounts, percentages and percentage change.
discount-percentage-calculator.formula: Discount = marked price × discount rate ÷ 100; sale price = marked price − discount. Percentage change = (new − original) ÷ |original| × 100.
discount-percentage-calculator.assumptions: Uses the entered values and does not include shipping, taxes or seller-specific rounding.

percentage-change-calculator.title: Percentage Change Calculator
percentage-change-calculator.description: Calculate percentage increase or decrease between two values.
percentage-change-calculator.formula: ((new value − original value) ÷ |original value|) × 100; zero original value is rejected.
percentage-change-calculator.assumptions: Percentage change is undefined when the original value is zero.

average-calculator.title: Average Calculator
average-calculator.description: Calculate mean, median, mode and range from a list of numbers.
average-calculator.formula: Mean = sum ÷ count; median is the middle sorted value (or mean of two middle values); mode is the most frequent value; range = maximum − minimum.
inputs: Numbers separated by commas, semicolons or spaces
outputs: Count, mean, median, mode and range
average-calculator.assumptions: All tokens must parse as finite numbers. If every value occurs once, no repeated mode is reported.

fraction-calculator.title: Fraction Calculator
fraction-calculator.description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions.
fraction-calculator.formula: For a/b and c/d: addition/subtraction use (ad ± bc)/bd; multiplication uses ac/bd; division uses ad/bc.
fraction-calculator.assumptions: Numerators and denominators must be integers; denominators cannot be zero and division by a zero fraction is rejected.

age-calculator.title: Age Calculator
age-calculator.description: Calculate age in years, months and days from a birth date.
age-calculator.formula: Calendar difference between birth date and the selected as-of date, with day and month borrowing based on calendar month lengths.
age-calculator.assumptions: Uses calendar dates, not an average number of days per year. The as-of date must not precede the birth date.

date-difference-calculator.title: Date Difference Calculator
date-difference-calculator.description: Find the exact days, weeks and months between two dates.
date-difference-calculator.formula: Absolute difference in whole calendar days; weeks = days ÷ 7; average months = days ÷ 30.4375.
outputs: Days, weeks and approximate average months
date-difference-calculator.assumptions: Dates are parsed at local midnight; months are an average-length estimate, not calendar-month counting.

time-duration-calculator.title: Time Duration Calculator
time-duration-calculator.description: Calculate elapsed time between start and end times.
time-duration-calculator.formula: Elapsed minutes = end time − start time; if negative, add 1,440 minutes to represent an overnight interval.
time-duration-calculator.assumptions: Assumes a same-day interval unless the end time is earlier, in which case it assumes one midnight crossing.

profit-margin-calculator.title: Profit Margin Calculator
profit-margin-calculator.description: Calculate gross profit and profit margin from cost and selling price.
profit-margin-calculator.formula: Gross profit = selling price − cost; gross margin (%) = gross profit ÷ selling price × 100.
profit-margin-calculator.assumptions: Margin is undefined when selling price is zero; excludes operating expenses, tax and transaction fees.

markup-calculator.title: Markup Calculator
markup-calculator.description: Calculate selling price and markup percentage from cost.
markup-calculator.formula: Markup amount = cost × markup rate ÷ 100; selling price = cost + markup amount.
markup-calculator.assumptions: Markup is calculated on cost, not selling price; excludes tax and overhead unless included in cost.

break-even-calculator.title: Break-even Calculator
break-even-calculator.description: Calculate break-even sales volume from fixed and variable costs.
break-even-calculator.formula: Break-even units = fixed costs ÷ (selling price per unit − variable cost per unit).
break-even-calculator.assumptions: Requires selling price above variable cost. Assumes constant prices, unit costs and fixed costs.

sales-tax-calculator.title: Sales Tax Calculator
sales-tax-calculator.description: Add or remove a configurable sales tax percentage.
sales-tax-calculator.formula: Add mode: tax = amount × rate/100 and total = amount + tax. Remove mode: base = inclusive amount ÷ (1+rate/100), tax = inclusive amount − base.
inputs: Add tax or extract included tax
sales-tax-calculator.assumptions: The entered rate is applied uniformly. The tool is not a substitute for jurisdiction-specific tax advice.

salary-breakdown-calculator.title: Salary Breakdown Calculator
salary-breakdown-calculator.description: Convert gross salary between monthly and annual amounts and estimate take-home after a simple deduction rate.
salary-breakdown-calculator.formula: Estimated deduction = gross monthly salary × deduction rate/100; estimated take-home = gross − deduction; annual figures are monthly values × 12.
outputs: Monthly gross, deduction and take-home; annualized equivalents
salary-breakdown-calculator.assumptions: Uses one flat editable deduction rate; it is not a statutory payroll or income-tax calculation.

savings-goal-calculator.title: Savings Goal Calculator
savings-goal-calculator.description: Estimate monthly savings needed to reach a target by a chosen date.
savings-goal-calculator.formula: Monthly saving required = (target − already saved) ÷ months to goal.
savings-goal-calculator.assumptions: Assumes equal contributions and no interest, investment return, fees or inflation.

reading-time-calculator.title: Reading Time Calculator
reading-time-calculator.description: Estimate reading time from word count using an adjustable reading speed.
reading-time-calculator.formula: Estimated minutes = word count ÷ selected reading speed (words per minute).
outputs: Word count and estimated reading time
reading-time-calculator.assumptions: A simple average estimate; actual reading speed varies with language, complexity and reader.

bmi-calculator.title: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Calculate body mass index from height and weight with standard adult categories.
bmi-calculator.formula: BMI = weight in kilograms ÷ (height in metres)².
outputs: BMI value and standard adult category
bmi-calculator.assumptions: Uses standard adult BMI categories; BMI is a screening measure and not a diagnosis or suitable standalone assessment for children or pregnancy.

bmr-calculator.title: BMR Calculator
bmr-calculator.description: Estimate basal metabolic rate using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
bmr-calculator.formula: Mifflin–St Jeor: male BMR = 10W + 6.25H − 5A + 5; female BMR = 10W + 6.25H − 5A − 161.
bmr-calculator.assumptions: An equation-based estimate for adults; actual energy needs vary and the sex coefficient is a model input, not a clinical assessment.

tip-calculator.title: Tip Calculator
tip-calculator.description: Calculate a restaurant tip, total bill and per-person split.
tip-calculator.formula: Tip = bill × tip rate/100; total = bill + tip; per-person share = total ÷ people.
outputs: Tip amount, total bill and per-person amount
tip-calculator.assumptions: Assumes an equal split and does not account for service charges or tax unless included in bill.

split-bill-calculator.title: Split Bill Calculator
split-bill-calculator.description: Divide a shared bill between people and include an optional extra amount.
split-bill-calculator.formula: Per-person amount = (bill + extra amount) ÷ number of people.
outputs: Total shared amount and each person's share
split-bill-calculator.assumptions: Assumes an equal split among a positive whole number of people.

simple-interest-calculator.title: Simple Interest Calculator
simple-interest-calculator.description: Calculate simple interest and total maturity value from principal, rate and time.
simple-interest-calculator.formula: Simple interest = principal × annual rate × time ÷ 100; maturity value = principal + interest.
simple-interest-calculator.assumptions: Assumes a constant annual rate and no compounding, fees, tax or interim payments.

commission-calculator.title: Commission Calculator
commission-calculator.description: Calculate commission earnings from a sale amount and commission percentage.
commission-calculator.assumptions: Assumes a flat commission percentage on the entire entered sales amount.

hourly-to-salary-calculator.title: Hourly to Salary Calculator
hourly-to-salary-calculator.description: Convert an hourly wage into estimated weekly, monthly and annual earnings.
hourly-to-salary-calculator.formula: Weekly earnings = hourly wage × hours per week; annual estimate = weekly earnings × 52; monthly estimate = annual estimate ÷ 12.
outputs: Weekly, monthly and annual gross earnings
hourly-to-salary-calculator.assumptions: Assumes 52 paid weeks per year and no overtime, unpaid leave, tax or benefits.

percentage-of-number-calculator.title: Percentage of a Number Calculator
percentage-of-number-calculator.description: Calculate a percentage of any number and show the remaining value.
percentage-of-number-calculator.formula: Percentage amount = value × rate ÷ 100; remainder = value − percentage amount.
percentage-of-number-calculator.assumptions: Uses the entered rate directly; negative values are mathematically permitted where the tool accepts them.

gcd-lcm-calculator.title: GCD and LCM Calculator
gcd-lcm-calculator.description: Find the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two integers.
gcd-lcm-calculator.formula: GCD is found using the Euclidean algorithm; LCM = |a × b| ÷ GCD (with zero handled as zero).
outputs: Greatest common divisor and least common multiple
gcd-lcm-calculator.assumptions: Inputs are expected to be integers; results are exact for safe integer inputs.

date-add-subtract-calculator.title: Date Add or Subtract Calculator
date-add-subtract-calculator.description: Add or subtract a number of days from a starting date.
date-add-subtract-calculator.formula: Result date = starting date shifted by the signed number of calendar days.
date-add-subtract-calculator.assumptions: Uses calendar-day arithmetic; it does not skip weekends or public holidays.

business-days-calculator.title: Business Days Calculator
business-days-calculator.description: Count weekdays between two dates, excluding Saturdays and Sundays.
business-days-calculator.formula: Counts Monday–Friday dates in the selected date interval, excluding Saturdays and Sundays.
business-days-calculator.assumptions: Public holidays are not excluded. Confirm whether the interval endpoints are included in the implementation before relying on the count.

aspect-ratio-calculator.title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
aspect-ratio-calculator.description: Calculate image aspect ratio and derive a missing width or height.
aspect-ratio-calculator.formula: Aspect ratio = width ÷ height, reduced by the greatest common divisor; the same ratio is used to derive a missing dimension.
outputs: Reduced aspect ratio and derived dimension
aspect-ratio-calculator.assumptions: Requires positive dimensions. Pixel dimensions do not determine physical print size without resolution metadata.

nepali-vat-calculator.title: Nepal VAT Calculator (13%)
nepali-vat-calculator.description: Add 13% VAT to a price or extract VAT from a VAT-inclusive amount in Nepalese rupees.
nepali-vat-calculator.formula: Add: VAT = base amount × rate/100; total = base + VAT. Remove: base = inclusive amount ÷ (1+rate/100); VAT = inclusive amount − base.
outputs: Base amount, VAT amount and VAT-inclusive total
nepali-vat-calculator.assumptions: The interface defaults to 13% but allows editing. Confirm current Inland Revenue Department rules and applicable exemptions.

neb-gpa-calculator.title: NEB GPA Calculator
neb-gpa-calculator.description: Calculate a credit-weighted GPA from NEB subject grade points and credit hours.
neb-gpa-calculator.formula: Credit-weighted GPA = Σ(credit hours × grade point) ÷ Σ(credit hours).
outputs: Total credit hours and weighted GPA
neb-gpa-calculator.assumptions: Uses grade points entered by the user; the UI grade-point mapping must match the applicable NEB grading framework and transcript.

nepal-share-calculator.title: NEPSE Share Buy/Sell Profit Calculator
nepal-share-calculator.description: Estimate share purchase cost, sale proceeds, charges and profit using editable broker, SEBON, DP and CGT assumptions.
nepal-share-calculator.formula: Buy value = shares × buy price; sell value = shares × sell price; estimated charges use editable broker and SEBON rates plus DP charge; profit = sell value − buy value − buy charges − sell charges; CGT estimate = max(0, profit) × entered CGT rate/100.
inputs: Buy and sell price per share (NPR)
outputs: Buy value, estimated buy/sell charges, gross profit, net profit and estimated CGT
nepal-share-calculator.assumptions: All fee and tax rates are editable assumptions. Actual broker charges, holding-period tax rules and applicable regulations must be checked for the trade date.

nepal-salary-tax-calculator.title: Nepal Salary Tax Calculator FY 2083/84
nepal-salary-tax-calculator.description: Estimate annual and monthly resident individual income tax using the published Nepal FY 2083/84 progressive tax bands.
nepal-salary-tax-calculator.formula: Progressive annual income tax = sum of each applicable tax-band slice × its statutory marginal rate; monthly estimate = annual estimate ÷ 12.
inputs: Annual salary and applicable resident individual tax inputs (as implemented)
outputs: Estimated annual and monthly income tax
nepal-salary-tax-calculator.assumptions: The catalog labels FY 2083/84. Verify tax bands, thresholds, deductions, residency and fiscal-year rules against current official IRD guidance before use.

nepal-electricity-bill-calculator.title: NEA Electricity Bill Calculator
nepal-electricity-bill-calculator.description: Estimate a Nepal single-phase domestic electricity bill by monthly units and meter capacity with energy blocks, minimum charge and VAT assumptions.
nepal-electricity-bill-calculator.formula: Estimated bill = sum of applicable energy-block charges + minimum charge (where applicable) + VAT under the configured tariff and meter-capacity assumptions.
outputs: Energy charge, minimum charge, VAT and estimated total
nepal-electricity-bill-calculator.assumptions: Must use the current NEA domestic single-phase tariff blocks and capacity-specific minimum charges; tariffs can change and should be independently verified.

nepse-dividend-calculator.title: NEPSE Dividend & Bonus Share Calculator
nepse-dividend-calculator.description: Estimate cash dividends after an editable withholding-tax assumption and calculate bonus-share entitlement from your holdings.
nepse-dividend-calculator.formula: Cash dividend = eligible investment amount × cash dividend rate; estimated net cash = gross cash dividend − withholding tax. Bonus shares = eligible shareholding × bonus rate/100.
inputs: Share quantity or eligible investment basis (as required)
outputs: Gross and net cash dividend; estimated bonus shares
nepse-dividend-calculator.assumptions: Rates and withholding treatment are issuer- and fiscal-year-specific. Check the official corporate action and current tax rules; fractional bonus entitlement may be rounded by the issuer.
